nodeContract.satisfactionLaw: A satisfied node has at least one verified evidence reference. On an ordered formation edge, predecessorEvidenceSha256 equals the source node's first evidence SHA and coverageManifestSha256 binds the complete family denominator. Rejected or superseded evidence never satisfies an edge.
